Vendored three.js builds (MIT, SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT,
Copyright 2010-2024 Three.js Authors)

- three.module.min.js  — three r170 module build, from
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.min.js
- OrbitControls.js     — three r170 OrbitControls addon, from
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js
- GLTFLoader.js        — three r170 GLTFLoader addon, from
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js
  (one local edit: its '../utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js' import was rewritten to
  './utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js' so it resolves under /static/)
- BufferGeometryUtils.js — three r170 addon, from
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js

Served by the web app as static scripts:
- /static/three.module.js
- /static/orbit-controls.js
- /static/gltf-loader.js
- /static/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js

The app keeps its zero-runtime-npm-dependency rule: the pinned builds are committed here instead of
installed, and the license headers are preserved in the files themselves.

anatomy-muscles.glb — the 3D muscle figure on the Muscle tab, derived from BodyParts3D release 4.0
(https://dbarchive.biosciencedbc.jp/en/bodyparts3d/desc.html). Required attribution:
"BodyParts3D, (c) The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International".
Built from the per-part OBJ meshes (skin excluded: muscles over bones) with Blender 5.2; the build
scripts and the curated region mapping live in tmp/bp3d and docs/MUSCLE-ANATOMY-3D-RESEARCH.md.
Served at /static/anatomy-muscles.glb.
